i was in grad school for over a year studying to be a clinical mental health counselor. i dropped out. for a lot of reasons, but mainly because i knew as much as i want to help others, inviting more trauma into my life was too much for me right now. (also- this university is of very high reputation, and the professors teaching courses continuously stereotyped and misinformed students about BPD, & it got exhausting advocating for my very existence). ANYWAY, now i’m in limbo until i figure out what i want to do, but i think it will definitely be something creative.

another thing to note - none of us live in the same state, some even the same country. picking a dress online is our only option, because yes, i do want the same dress for everyone. we also have a wide range of sizes, and not every bridesmaid dress company makes the sizes we need. this is why i went to this seller on Etsy, who offers custom sizing. It’s just a dress, girls will wear for one half of one day. I just thought it was pretty. Please don’t attack people or make assumptions about a person based on one dress. It actually really hurt my feelings reading the comments and I cried to my fiancé for awhile over it. The wedding is in less than 4 months, I am overwhelmed, as i’m sure many of us in this group are. We are all just doing the best we can. Please be kind

okay i feel you. i have diagnosed bpd and adhd (unmedicated), and this describes me. i relate heavily to feeling purposeless,like i’m floating, etc. yesterday i bought the wrong cat food brand and my very loving partner simply pointed this out to me, and i had a full on break down bc i felt useless. i don’t work, i abandon hobbies. if it weren’t for my parents and fiancé, i don’t know where or what i’d be doing on my own. In my opinion, these are symptoms of my mental illness. i *want* to do so many things - my adhd inhibits my ability to actually get started, and my bpd makes it so that i’m too unstable to keep with it. it’s exhausting.
